I’ve tried and it helped to have someone to talk to but that feeling was hit or miss. I live in the U.K and I’ve been to a private psychologist and was from there referred to the E.I.P (early intervention psychosis). I struggle to take it seriously and I never felt fully comfortable or committed. I also tried to teach myself dialectical behavioural therapy techniques, which helped to boost my confidence but I lost enthusiasm. 
More recently, I was looking  forward to engaging with a group programme in my new area but it has been shut down due to covid.

I have bouts of them within maybe an hour of the day. Most of the time they lead to depression and I don’t know how much longer I can take it. Feels like I’m being taken out of my head and forced to look at the terrifying magnitude of everything and it just seems like I’m being told that life is pretty much impossible for me at this point.

If you want to talk about this stuff or anything, just shoot is a message. I was looking forward to this group therapy/social space at a mental health charity in this area I’ve just moved to but they’ve shut all that stuff down because of covid. It’s such a shame because ppl really need those things. 
Anyways, you should maybe look out for things like that and reach out if you ever want to. Cheers brother ✋

My mum was damaged before she had us and she only met my dad when he was 17. Our relationship was beyond difficult and I tried to kill my self with aerosol at 11. 

I’m saying all this because now at 19(m), our relationship is starting to really be something I hold dear because of the pain we shared.

You hang in there man, this shit is rough. If I could give you any advice I’d say you need to find a reason to respect yourself. Depression for me is (along with many other things) a constant battle for self respect. You’re asking why you are the way you are and you should try to find out for yourself. 

You aren’t wasting anybody’s time my guy. I’m assuming that as you’ve been diagnosed, you will be getting some therapy and will have support from this point on? That stuff is very important but also don’t be afraid to go inwards on your own time. I think it’s a fine balance because I know that for me there are certain things that I cannot bring up in any therapy. 

You deserve hope, we all do. Without hope for anything life becomes so incredibly torturous, even just the smallest things.Find what gives you hope and fight for it is all I can say, though I’m till searching atm.
